questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at the marked stop line. Then proceed only when it is safe. If there is no stop line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop before the intersection where you can see oncoming traffic.

questions.question: Motorcyclists are entitled to use the full width of a traffic lane. Pass a motorcycle the same way you would pass another vehicle.
questions.explanation: Even if there is room in the lane for both a car and a motorcycle, the motorcyclist needs the full lane to stay safe. Do not share the lane with motorcyclists.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
You will always stop at the upcoming railroad crossing.
You should stop and wait for a signal before crossing the railroad tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is coming. Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop. Wait for any trains to pass before you go.

questions.question: Before returning to your original lane after passing another vehicle, you should:

options.text: See both headlights of the passed vehicle in your rearview mirror.

questions.correctAnswerText: See both headlights of the passed vehicle in your rearview mirror.
questions.explanation: When passing, wait until you see both headlights of the passed vehicle in your rearview mirror. Only then is it safe to return to your original lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp turn to the right ahead.
Upcoming sharp left and right turns.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road ahead has many turns. Slow down and adjust your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way road, entrance, or exit. If you see this sign, traffic is moving toward you. Turn around immediately if you are driving toward this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Last turn before a toll road.

questions.explanation: Orange signs, cones, and barrels mean work zone activity ahead. Stay alert for unexpected driving conditions. This sign tells you a flagger is ahead. Obey the flagger's directions.

questions.question: You can make a right turn against a red signal light after stopping and yielding to other vehicles and pedestrians.
questions.explanation: You may turn right at a red light unless a sign says you cannot. You must stop completely first and yield to all other drivers and pedestrians.

questions.question: If you are driving on a highway next to a single broken white line marking:

options.text: You cannot cross the line to pass.
You may cross the line to pass and change lanes.
You may only cross the line to change lanes if you are in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may cross the line to pass and change lanes.
questions.explanation: White dashed lines separate lanes of traffic going the same direction. You may cross a dashed white line to pass or change lanes if it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is posted on one-way streets and other roads where you cannot enter. You may see this sign if you try to enter an expressway ramp going the wrong way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells drivers that bicycles may be crossing in this area.

questions.question: When meeting another vehicle, you must dim your high beams within how many feet?
questions.explanation: Dim your high beams 500 feet before you meet an oncoming vehicle. Dim them 300 feet before passing a vehicle ahead of you.

questions.question: At a crosswalk:

options.text: Construction workers must yield to you.

questions.explanation: Pedestrians have the right-of-way at crossings if they obey traffic signals. You must stop for pedestrians in marked or unmarked crosswalks.

questions.question: Why should drivers give extra space to children on bicycles?

options.text: They do not have the same physical reflexes as adults.
They are smaller and harder to see than adults.

questions.explanation: Children are unpredictable and hard to see. Watch carefully for children near schools, bus stops, playgrounds, and parks. They may ride on the sidewalk and suddenly enter the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Proceed at a consistent speed while looking and listening for approaching trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing with this sign, slow down and look both ways. Listen for trains and be ready to stop. Never try to go around a train.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An octagonal (eight-sided) sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at this sign.

questions.question: A broken yellow line between two lanes of traffic means:

options.text: Both lanes of traffic are going in the same direction.
Passing is permitted when it's safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Passing is permitted when it's safe.
questions.explanation: Dashed yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. You can pass when there is no oncoming traffic in the passing lane.

questions.question: How can you avoid skidding on slippery surfaces?

options.text: Shift to a lower gear after starting down a steep hill.
Speed up to enter curves and slow down to exit them.
Slow down before entering curves and intersections.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down before entering curves and intersections.
questions.explanation: Slow down before entering a curve because you cannot see what is ahead. Braking on a curve can cause you to skid.

questions.question: "No zones" are areas around trucks where cars:

options.text: Disappear into blind spots or are so close that they restrict the truck driver's ability to stop and maneuver safely.
Have sufficient space to travel behind the truck.
Have several car lengths between their vehicle and the truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: Disappear into blind spots or are so close that they restrict the truck driver's ability to stop and maneuver safely.
questions.explanation: "No zones" are blind spots around trucks or buses. They are also areas where cars are so close they prevent the truck driver from stopping or turning safely. Being in a "No zone" greatly increases crash risk.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flagger is ahead. Always follow the flagger's directions. Flaggers wear bright orange, yellow, or yellow-green clothing. They use paddles and red flags to direct traffic and let workers and construction vehicles cross the road.

questions.question: If a police officer pulls you over, should you immediately get out of your car and walk toward the officer's car?
questions.explanation: Stay in your car when pulled over. Keep both hands visible on the steering wheel.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no slower than 35 mph around the upcoming curve.
Slow down to 35 mph or less for the upcoming curve.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down to 35 mph or less for the upcoming curve.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about conditions coming up ahead. These signs may show a speed you should use for safety.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around and go in the opposite direction at this location.

questions.question: Which of the following commonly causes traffic crashes?

options.text: Speeding and driving too fast for the conditions.
Getting enough rest and staying alert.
Watching the road and focusing on driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Speeding and driving too fast for the conditions.
questions.explanation: Driving above the speed limit and driving too fast for road conditions cause many crashes. Always drive at a safe speed within the legal limit.

questions.question: How long before turning should you signal in a business or residential area?
questions.explanation: In a business or residential area, signal for at least 100 feet before turning. In other areas, signal for at least 200 feet before turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right turn on red light is okay with caution.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means right turns are prohibited.

questions.question: Slow vehicles should use the left-hand lane except when passing or turning left.
questions.explanation: Slow vehicles must use the right-hand lane except when passing or turning left.

questions.question: If you need to use your lights while driving in bad weather or low light:
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights in fog, snow, or rain. High beams reflect light back at you, creating glare and making it harder to see.

questions.question: When driving at night on a dark street, you should:

options.text: Drive slow enough to stop within the light from your headlights.
Use high beam headlights to see cars ahead better.
Keep dashboard lights bright so other drivers can see you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive slow enough to stop within the light from your headlights.
questions.explanation: Drive slower at night because you cannot see as far ahead. Make sure you can stop within the area lit by your headlights.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign means "stop."
